evidence_boundary: Inherited actual static photographs and primary teaching text, frozen RSSF mesh/rig and keyboard. No viewed black-key video, no measured physiological joint limits or biomechanics certification.

NATURAL_IDLE_FINGERS.REFERENCE_SUPPORTED: R2 S1/S2 qualitative varied finger curves; S1 includes an E task, not three-idle ground truth.
NATURAL_IDLE_FINGERS.GEOMETRY_DERIVED: Canonical RSSF curved rest and existing digit chains.
NATURAL_IDLE_FINGERS.ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Nonuniform positive RSSF-relative curvature with inward index/ring base spread, bounded moderate increments; no fake home-key targets for left idle three. Human explicitly rejected the R1 straight/splayed result.
NATURAL_IDLE_FINGERS.UNKNOWN: Exact performer-dependent passive coupling and teacher-approved curve.

ACTIVE_FINGER_CONTACT.REFERENCE_SUPPORTED: R2 S3 confirms D/E/F#/G/A fingering text; not D5 repertoire approval.
ACTIVE_FINGER_CONTACT.GEOMETRY_DERIVED: Frozen existing pads and actual playable surfaces, black-key raised/rearward geometry.
ACTIVE_FINGER_CONTACT.ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Fit rigid pad and predicted skin pad jointly; evaluate actual saved/reopened skin as well.
ACTIVE_FINGER_CONTACT.UNKNOWN: Finite pressure/contact area and soft tissue compression.

SHARED_PALM_CONFIGURATION.REFERENCE_SUPPORTED: Single hand distributes several digit positions in real static photographs.
SHARED_PALM_CONFIGURATION.ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Each pair shares exactly the same six-DOF root; separate bounded digit rotations. No individual-finger roots.
SHARED_PALM_CONFIGURATION.UNKNOWN: Dynamic transition and physiological maximum span.

WRIST_ORIENTATION.REFERENCE_SUPPORTED: R2 S5 avoids outward twisting; wrist freedom is qualitative.
WRIST_ORIENTATION.GEOMETRY_DERIVED: Frozen keyboard axes and wrist origin.
WRIST_ORIENTATION.ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Yaw ±12°, pitch -6°..10°, roll ±6°, before result inspection. Paired scenes share exact root. These are a priori engineering policy, not physiology.
WRIST_ORIENTATION.UNKNOWN: Human anatomical limits and arm/elbow/shoulder context.

PALM_CLEARANCE.REFERENCE_SUPPORTED: Product naturalness requirement; hidden palm underside not measured in sources.
PALM_CLEARANCE.GEOMETRY_DERIVED: Canonical palm/wrist vertices and frozen rectangular key surfaces/volumes.
PALM_CLEARANCE.ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: 5mm palm/wrist planning volume distance; cap wrist-root z to68mm left/65mm right; no lifting both hands arbitrarily to escape neighbors.
PALM_CLEARANCE.UNKNOWN: Complete triangle collision or load-bearing tissue model.

NEIGHBOR_KEY_CLEARANCE.REFERENCE_SUPPORTED: Only qualitative keyboard proximity, not measured clearances.
NEIGHBOR_KEY_CLEARANCE.GEOMETRY_DERIVED: All 88 keys and sampled evaluated hand vertices.
NEIGHBOR_KEY_CLEARANCE.ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Use complete unchanged 3300-vertex linear-blend skin prediction in a signed key-piece-box distance penalty, including the previously missed side vertices. Full saved/reopened screen and normal views remain final checks.
NEIGHBOR_KEY_CLEARANCE.UNKNOWN: Zero false negatives for finite triangle intersections.

JOINT_POSTURE.REFERENCE_SUPPORTED: R2 S5 supported fifth-finger joints; no exact angles inferred.
JOINT_POSTURE.GEOMETRY_DERIVED: Existing canonical rests/local rotation axes and unchanged drivers.
JOINT_POSTURE.ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Below numeric increments are design bounds, never physiological limits. Positive flex only, base spread only, no axial twist.
JOINT_POSTURE.UNKNOWN: Teacher approved joint domain and deformation under every pose.

coordinate_frame.units: equivalent scale metres internally, mm for reports
coordinate_frame.reason: Static surface-contact geometry; no key press animation or action is generated.

root_bounds.interpretation: Common root can differ from R1. Left maximum root height reduced70→68mm; right65mm cap. Root bounds decided before solve.

joint_increment_bounds_deg.meaning: Flexion1/2/3 then base spread. Increment from already curved RSSF rest; not global anatomical joint angles.

contact_regions.prepared_white_allowed: Union of actual front/rear surfaces, 3mm lateral inset and 7mm outer front/rear inset, no artificial gap at internal front/rear interface. Left endpoints prefer front; active white tasks use front.
contact_regions.right_index_ring_preparation: Actual WHITE front piece only, y in7..45mm; full skin distance to black sides also penalized. No isolated lifting of index/ring, root and all digits solved jointly.
contact_regions.left_idle_targets: NONE; no home keys for index/middle/ring

solver.method: One deterministic joint least-squares solve per shared-root hand-pair, collectively one four-pose candidate; no restart, sweep or candidate selection.
solver.skin_proxy: Full 3300-vertex linear-blend prediction from unchanged R1 extracted mesh/weights; no generated deformation or modified weights. Blender preserved drivers evaluated after save/reopen.
solver.proxy_sampling: ALL3300 vertices. R1 key-boundary misses are included, not just8 low sample vertices.
solver.priority: Hard no-reverse bounded joint domain and paired common root, nonuniform idle curvature/spacing, whole-skin neighbors and palm clearances, active fixed/skin contact, natural preparation. Conflicts remain failure; never relax after inspecting.
solver.failure_rule: Max evaluations/nonconvergence with usable finite pose is reported as solver limit and still rendered; cannot prove geometric impossibility.
solver.initialization: One deterministic RSSF-prior initialization per hand-pair with declared root seeds; no alternate candidate seeds.
solver.full_vertex_penalty: SDF of union of inherited frozen rectangular key pieces;2mm neighboring-key skin margin;5mm palm/wrist margin. Target-key distal active patch permits0mm distance. Distal patch rest radius18mm from fixed mesh pad, selected before solve.
solver.planned_key_band_reason: Broad fixed geometric bands around complete allowed root/hand extent; final screen independently checks all88 keys.
solver.joint_boundary_relief: Penalty within final10% of active/endpoint flex bounds; cannot change hard limits. Does not certify low muscular load.

acceptance.geometry_contact: Fixed pad inside actual playable region and absolute vertical gap <=3mm; skin pad gap independently reported.
acceptance.clearance: Screen actual evaluated mesh against all frozen key volumes at >3mm depth; confirm human-visible issues through side images.
acceptance.naturalness: Normal top/side/close agent precheck, then HUMAN_PENDING. Bounds/contact alone never make naturalness PASS.
acceptance.sequence: Shared root is a necessary pair relationship only; no continuous transition is generated or proven.

human_feedback_authority.LEFT_NATURALNESS: NOT_APPROVED: idle three too straight/splayed, tense, bounds saturated

scope: One coordinated shared-root static refinement; never alter mesh/rest/weights/drivers/key geometry/material.
